name: Novation Circuit Tracks
description: Novation Circuit Tracks, both synths, the drums and the project, by the control changes and NRPNs of its programmer's reference.

sources.title: Circuit Tracks Programmer's Reference Guide v3
sources.notes: MIDI parameter table (pages 3-12) read by tools/profiles/novation/read-novation-pdf.mjs from circuit_tracks_programmer_s_reference_guide_v3.pdf (sha256 2d2c8e12d5f987b021b17c19efed0faaa77ad651b061ff019740a8e85d117e5e), https://downloads.novationmusic.com/novation/circuit/circuit-tracks. authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the guide prints no Device Inquiry reply.
Messages that carry several switches, each with values of its own, a choice each: NRPN 0:122, NRPN 0:123. CEditor does not attribute one of these to a parameter when the instrument sends it.

Left out, the audio table on p. 9, for which the guide prints no channel: Audio 1 level (CC 13), Audio 2 level (CC 15), Audio 1 reverb level (CC 31), Audio 2 reverb level (CC 32), Audio 1 delay level (CC 33), Audio 2 delay level (CC 34), Audio 1 Pan (CC 35), Audio 2 Pan (CC 36).

67 choice(s), their names from the value tables the rows point to (Filter Table, Osc Waveform Table, Distortion Table, Mod Matrix Table, LFO Waveform Table) where a table numbers every value of the range, or from the rows' own notes.

A number, not a choice, where the value table it points to does not number its whole range: Mod Matrix Table (Source) numbers 0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 for a range of 0 - 12: Synth 1 Mod matrix 1 source 1, Synth 2 Mod matrix 1 source 1, Synth 1 Mod matrix 1 source 2, Synth 2 Mod matrix 1 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 2 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 2 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 2 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 2 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 3 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 3 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 3 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 3 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 4 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 4 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 4 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 4 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 5 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 5 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 5 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 5 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 6 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 6 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 6 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 6 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 7 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 7 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 7 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 7 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 8 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 8 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 8 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 8 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 9 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 9 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 9 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 9 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 10 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 10 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 10 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 10 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 11 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 11 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 11 source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 11 source 2, Synth 1 mod matrix 12 source 1, Synth 2 mod matrix 12 source 1, Synth 1 mod matrix 12 Source 2, Synth 2 mod matrix 12 Source 2.
Pages 3-8: Synth 1 on the channel variable (channel 1), Synth 2 on the synth2Channel variable (channel 2); "Send messages on MIDI Channel 1 for Synth 1 and Channel 2 for Synth" 2.
Pages 11-11: Drums on the drumChannel variable (channel 10); "Messages on MIDI Channel 10".
Pages 12-12: Project on the projectChannel variable (channel 16); "Send messages on MIDI Channel 16".

Pull: Current Patch Dump Request for each synth (location 00 for Synth 1, 01 for Synth 2), answered by Replace Current Patch with 340 bytes of plain 7-bit data. 548 parameter(s) are read back from the patch format's addresses: a byte where its range is the parameter's, a flag by its bits.
The reference says the instrument answers a patch dump request "to its USB port" only, whichever port the request came in on.
In the patch but not read back, its range in the patch (58 - 69) is not the parameter's: Voice_KeyboardOctave.

In the patch with no parameter of the same name here: Patch_Category, Patch_Genre, ModMatrix13_Source1, ModMatrix13_Source2, ModMatrix13_Depth, ModMatrix13_Destination, ModMatrix14_Source1, ModMatrix14_Source2, ModMatrix14_Depth, ModMatrix14_Destination, ModMatrix15_Source1, ModMatrix15_Source2, ModMatrix15_Depth, ModMatrix15_Destination, ModMatrix16_Source1, ModMatrix16_Source2, ModMatrix16_Depth, ModMatrix16_Destination, ModMatrix17_Source1, ModMatrix17_Source2, ModMatrix17_Depth, ModMatrix17_Destination, ModMatrix18_Source1, ModMatrix18_Source2, ModMatrix18_Depth, ModMatrix18_Destination, ModMatrix19_Source1, ModMatrix19_Source2, ModMatrix19_Depth, ModMatrix19_Destination, ModMatrix20_Source1, ModMatrix20_Source2, ModMatrix20_Depth, ModMatrix20_Destination.
